messages:
sam: quick follow-up from the postmortem on the morning latency surge. root cause was concurrent drain + aggressive scale-down on a subset of dedicated pools. proposing short-term SLO tweaks + owners so we avoid repeated weekday hits.

nina: agree. i'll draft an SLO amendment: widen p95 threshold to 225ms during 06:00-09:00 UTC and evaluate for 2 weeks. i'll own the doc and PR. due: 2026-03-29.

omar: i'll handle alerting changes. plan: add a "ramp-window" mute for paging for 30m and an early-warning non-pager. will update runbook with suppression rules. due: 2026-03-26.

zara: dashboard owner here. adding p95 5m/1h comparison panel, queue-depth panel, and an error-budget remaining gauge. will add links to postmortem and playbook. due: 2026-03-24.

sam: action items summary:
- SLO amend (p95 relax 200->225ms during 06:00-09:00 UTC for 2 weeks): owner nina; due 2026-03-29.
- Alert cooldown + early-warning (30m mute for paging): owner omar; due 2026-03-26.
- Dashboards + links (p95 panels, queue depth, eb gauge): owner zara; due 2026-03-24.
- Autoscaler fix: honor drain hooks and add conservative scale-down lock for 10m after burst; owner infra (sam coordinating); due 2026-04-05.
- Recurrence check: 60/90-day pattern analysis; owner nina; due 2026-03-31.

nina: i'll include metrics-backed rationale in the SLO PR (p95 histograms + cost tradeoffs).

omar: sample alert snippet i'll add to PR: alert if p95>300ms for 5m -> severity: warning; paging suppressed during ramp window unless error-budget <15%.

zara: prometheus drafts i'll push: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` and `sum(redwood_queue_length)` panels.

pager-bot: Incident 2026-03-27-09 closed. Postmortem uploaded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-27-morning-latency.

sam: thanks all. please @mention this thread when PRs/dashboards are ready. scheduling a 15min sync on 2026-03-28 13:00 UTC to validate changes.

nina: ack.

omar: ack.

zara: ack.
